headline: Exchange Inflows Fell To 716.9 Million Dollars As OKX Shed 226.6 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 716.9 million dollars across assets over 24 hours, 0.2667 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, down from 861.1 million dollars and 0.3163 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means that money arrived where holders can sell, and the smaller print means that arrival slowed. OKX's outflow widened to 226.6 million dollars from 152.8 million, Bitfinex shed 231.1 million, Binance took in 685.2 million, and Bitstamp took in 409.7 million.
author: jordan
